# Runbook: restarting the ingest worker

The ingest worker runs as a systemd service on ingest-01 and ingest-02. In order to restart it safely, drain the queue first by setting the INGEST_PAUSE flag in Consul and waiting until the queue depth reaches zero.

Once the queue is empty, run sudo systemctl restart ingest-worker on each host. The logs shows a line reading "worker ready" within about 20 seconds. If that line does not appear, do not restart the second host; page the on-call engineer instead.
